STATE: After Demo Day (Feb 26), investor from MOC reached out via message: 'Saw you at the latest basedspace tournament with Whisnap! Would love to learn more on the plans, how did it go? As MOC we're investing early, anywhere up to EUR 3M.'

Ned's response: Not motivated about Whisnap, doesn't know what to say on a call.

Draft reply (sent or ready to send): 'Hey, thanks for reaching out! Demo day went well — honest pitch, early stage. Launched MVP during the program, got initial users on board, now figuring out distribution. Would love to chat — happy to jump on a call this week or next, what works for you?'

Call prep framing:
- What you built: Local-first voice-to-text, free forever locally, $10/mo cloud AI refinement, solo built
- What you learned: Product works, distribution is the bottleneck
- Market validation: Wispr Flow raised $50M with 50 people, Ned is one guy
- Flip it back: Ask what stage they invest at, what their engagement looks like

KEY REFRAME: Meeting ≠ commitment. They're buying Ned (solo founder, marketer background, built product from scratch) not Whisnap.
